notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Izzet Chronarch each turn.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Izzet Chronarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
